The printed options did not include the correct answer (No court – DPSPs are not enforceable by any court); it is added as option 5.
Art. 37 makes DPSPs non-justiciable, so no court – district, High, Supreme or one of choice – will enforce them; the printed key 'any court of his choice' is wrong.

notes.text: - **Count:** the 42nd added **four** DPSPs (Laxmikanth's count; Rocket and PMF list the three new Articles 39A, 43A, 48A plus the recast 39(f)); with the 44th's 38(2), **five** new DPSPs in all.

exam: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I 2017
q: Which of the following Directive Principles was not originally provided for in the constitution of India?
options: Citizen's right to an adequate means of livelihood
Prohibition of the slaughter of cows and calves
explanation: Free legal aid (Art. 39A) was added by the 42nd Amendment (1976); livelihood (39(a)), village panchayats (40) and cow protection (48) are original.

notes.text: - **NOT by the 42nd:** cow-slaughter ban (48, original), UCC (44, original), equal pay (39(d), original), right to work (41, original), living wage (43, original), 38(2) (44th), 43B (97th), ECCE (86th).

exam: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
q: The practice of Panchayat Raj as mandated by Directive Principles of State Policy alone was not satisfactory because?
options: Villagers did not take much interest
Village was a small unit for administration
There was no uniform system amongst the States and elections were not regularly held
Villagers felt that they were safe in the hands of State Government only
key_text: There was no uniform system amongst the States and elections were not regularly held
explanation: Panchayats under Art. 40 alone lacked a uniform pattern and regular elections, which is why the 73rd Amendment (1992) gave them constitutional status.

notes.text: - Borrowed from the **Irish Constitution of 1937** ("Directive Principles of Social Policy"), which copied the **Spanish Constitution** – not the USA, USSR, France, Japan, Australia, England or Switzerland.

exam: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II 2017
q: Which Article of the Constitution provides justification for establishment of Nyaya Panchayats?
explanation: Nyaya Panchayats bring cheap justice to villages and draw on Art. 39A (equal justice and free legal aid); Art. 40 is about village panchayats as self-government.

notes.text: - **Constitution match (APPSC G2 Mains 2025):** UK – **rule of law**; Ireland – **DPSP**; USA – **judicial review**; Canada – **residual powers**.

q: Locate the Constitutional power which enabled the Central government to Legislate on cow slaughter
options: Entry 17, list 3 in schedule for prevention of cruelty to animals
key_text: Entry 17, list 3 in schedule for prevention of cruelty to animals
explanation: Cow slaughter is a State subject (State List Entry 15); the Centre's power comes from Concurrent List Entry 17, prevention of cruelty to animals; Art. 48 is only a non-enforceable directive.
